svg.text: Accepted reports; 40 speakers / 80 clips; means use equal speaker weights (two clips each) where available
C. RMS factorization · 40-speaker mean distance curves
Lag offset from zero (frames; fixed anchor at +3)
Panels A/B: four primary intervention ΔC estimates with accepted 99% CIs; gray joint contrasts are secondary. Curve panel: equal-speaker mean at each lag; C is not recalculated from the mean curve.
MEL q10/q01 = interior/boundary; RMS q10/q01 = direction/radius. Mouth aperture and speed have separate axes; tracks are observational and no physical overlay was applied.
